column4: built: isometric pixel art from Aseprite, a Konoha-like clearing under a cliff, cream blocks and round towers, terracotta roofs, rooftop tanks and washing lines, giant trees, anime ninjas with plated headbands, lit windows and lantern glow; missing: cloth banners, kunai pouches on the ninjas, blue-shifted shadows
warm hidden village in the trees, terracotta roofs, anime ninja silhouettes; nothing from the series itself
fixed 2:1 isometric view of the whole village, 480x270 scaled by a whole number
one screen; houses, towers, tanks, training ground, station, giant trees, lanterns, track and ground all from assets/src/*.aseprite
train arrives, slows, stops at stop_i, dwells, leaves; wheel frames swap with distance; smoke puffs at index.html:650; board and step off at index.html:657 and 668
routines pick training ground, shop, station, square or a walk; four-direction walk frames at index.html:285; walkers visible in evidence/play.png
training activity holds punch pose frames 8/9; sparring alternates punch and kick at index.html:425; punch frame in evidence/figures.png
a ninja hops roof to roof with afterimages every rooftop_gap seconds; log line in evidence/play.png
kids play tag (chase, tag, swap it, freeze); ninjas sprint at run_speed on errands; tag log lines in evidence/play.png
spar with crowd, messenger hawk with a runner, cat and sparrow, each logs lines; lantern round at index.html:609
daylight curve, night tint and glow at index.html:730, lit-window frames at night, lanterns lit by the round, villagers go home at index.html:235
Space pause, 1/2/3 speed, click picks the nearest villager and shows name and activity (index.html:823), H hides the HUD

kids and running ninjas

first train at train_first 6 s, slows into the station, passengers step off, waiting villagers board on departure

train at 6 s, rooftop dash at 8 s, first event at 10 s: all inside the first minute; the train leaves after train_dwell
